name: Mount GOA
author: uxuldavid
description: In the world where peace has reigned, there is a sacred mountain called "GOA". The creatures lived for themselves, not knowing the troubles. Sinned often. And then one day the mountain got very angry and decided to cleanse this world of sinners. The creatures, not knowing where to find help, no longer hoped for anything. And then one day alien forces descended to them to help the creatures in this world find peace and quiet.
